feed.agency: Sistema Integrado de Transportación del Sur (SITRAS)

operators.name: Puerto Rico Highway and Transportation Authority – Público
operators.short: Puerto Rico Highway and Transportation Authority – Público

sources.name: ATI GTFS-Realtime (vehicle positions and arrival forecasts)
sources.detail: ATI's open data page lists GTFS-RT as "en desarrollo" (in development). No feed URL exists yet.

sources.name: AMA Móvil app (AMATrack)
sources.detail: The official AMA app shows bus positions, but there is no public data feed behind it.

sources.name: ATI express buses (T3, E10, E20, E30, E40, C22, C35, C36)
sources.detail: The independent app transPRte says it shows live positions for these routes "using the positions the operator publishes". The feed is not public; access has to be requested from ATI.

sources.name: Municipal bus and trolley systems
sources.detail: No municipal GTFS-RT feed exists in the public registries. Schedules are public for the systems listed under Operators.

sources.name: AcuaExpreso ferries (Hornblower)
sources.detail: ATI points riders to the City Experiences app for ferry tracking and service alerts. No public feed.

sources.name: Aircraft near Puerto Rico (ADS-B)
sources.detail: Community ADS-B networks publish free live positions, but their servers do not allow calls from a web page, so a small relay (a Cloudflare Worker or Azure Function) is needed.
